rotation_note: On an out-of-quota answer (Flow error with no image) the queue records the profile in results/controller/profile-exhaustion.json until the next local midnight (or quota_reset_hours) and continues on the next profile in priority that has a tool_url. CAPTCHA, sign-in, storage and unknown errors still stop the queue. Every decision is appended to results/controller/profile-switches.ndjson. machine.local.json overrides these keys.
